images.caption: Atlantic Ocean (Oct. 28, 2004) — The amphibious assault ship USS Bataan (LHD-5) passes the Fort Story Lighthouse on her way to the Atlantic Ocean for sea trials. This is the crew's first underway period after completing an extensive six-month availability at Norfolk Shipbuilding and Drydock Corporation.

images.caption: The council accepted the design for a new city flag of Virginia Beach, Virginia, on January 11, 1965. The design was chosen by a three-member flag committee. The flag design was modeled after the flag of the Commonwealth of Virginia, with a solid blue background with the official city seal placed in the center.
